builds.name: Quickened Klein
builds.desc: Klein's strengths lie with his ability to eliminate enemies on his turn, under his terms. While most people would recommend Luna because it will trigger almost just as frequently, Moonbow and Quickened Pulse make for a deadly combo that ensures his second consecutive blow will more than likely be a killing one.

builds.name: Thanks for not Foddering
builds.desc:
Klein’s tragic offensive stats make his base kit (which would be incredible on so many other units) unusable in a power-creeping meta where Legend Ike can have over 45 Def. He just doesn’t do enough damage, and his decent speed takes a devastating hit while using a brave bow.
So if you pull a +Speed Klein and wouldn’t rather have him for fodder, the higher damage, uncounterable Firesweep Bow+ turns him into a Brave Lyn-style menace who can teleport around the map doubling most units from complete safety. Guard, Cancel Affinity, Swordbreaker or Green Tomebreaker can also be strong options for his B slot depending on your style of play.
His low Attack stat still poses a problem against armored units and bruisers like Ephraim, Brave Lucina and Joshua, so Threaten Def is going to be his best C option. Luna is going to be his best option for breaking through those tankier units, even though it’s challenging to charge up. He pairs best with Infantry Pulse units, dancers, or units that can boost his offensive stats to turn him into an uncounterable monster. A mounted brawler like Sigurd can also work well by taking a hit on the front line and enabling Klein’s teleport.

builds.name: Offensive Klein Build
builds.desc: This is what I call the best offensive Klien you can get. Go for +spd with an easy 36 spd stat, and Hp can be thrown away. He can survive at least 1 hit most of the time, which allows him to get into Desperation Range, Water Blessing is the best choice for this Klein, Attack +3 Seal helps with his 31 base Attack but its also flexible to have the ability to get more spd as you wish with Speed +3, Threaten Spd with right positioning can easily make Klien able to double most units. Life and Death 3 gives him more attack, and gives enough spd to counter Brave Bow+ -5 speed reduction, This is a Expensive Build! If you going to go this far you might as well make him +10. anyway peace -zekam11 out.

builds.name: Updated Offensive Klein (Argent Bow)
builds.desc: An updated build for Klein that uses his relatively new signature weapon, Argent Bow, with no real-world resource investment (ie, no spending money on the game's microtransactions). Life and Death 3 is available from the 3-4 star unit Sothe at 4 star rarity, or from the free unit Zephiel at 5 stars if you're seriously desperate. Chill Spd comes from the free unit Panne at 5 stars, and at the time of writing, Even Atk Wave will be available soon from the free Fallen!Delthea at 4 stars. With this build, Klein becomes a speedy, hard-hitting archer few units can stand against.

builds.name: Silver Duelist
builds.desc:
Klein's excellent res stats are increased upon by his +Res IV, a +Res refine, and a seal that improves his res even more. I recommend placing him on an infantry team for best effect. A hero with Infantry Pulse can help speed up Klein's initial 4 charge special, and Klein having -HP IVs ensures that he will gain from its effects. However, I still recommend the HP/Res seal to give him a little more bulk. With that and his weapon refine, he should have a relatively low(but still respectable) 44 HP(give or take, depending on merges and dragonflowers). Speaking of weapons, a +Res Guard Bow is the way to go, and is the best option for an enemy-phase archer. Reposition/Swap helps Klein move his allies out of danger and put himself in range for the enemy phase. Glacies packs enough punch to affect those with even the highest defense. Mirror Stance, when coupled with Guard Bow+ refine and Klein's +Res enhancements, gives Klein a whopping 44 Res on enemy phase, and helps shore up Klein's middling Atk. Quick Riposte patches up Klein's mediocre spd and helps the enemy phase aspect even more. Odd/Even Def Wave can help improve Klein's own relatively poor def, as well as the def of those around him.
For a bonus, make Klein's Support Partner M! Corrin with the Yato refine for an aditional +6 to every stat when they are adjacent(note that this is entirely optional; and that Klein without this support partner still functions perfectly well, but if you want this build to go from "Impressive Enemy phase duelist" to "Literally all four horsemen of the apocalypse at once," I highly recommend it). Klein's seal is pretty flexible, but I prefer HP/Res for previously stated reasons. If you want to increase his defensive capabilities even more, give him something like Distant Def 3. Either way, this build will get you through just about any game mode, provided you have a healer handy for chain battles.
